name: A manager-mediated house does not expose a resident self-service queue

statusDetails.message: House A is manager routed with manager operator; house B is self-service. Served UI renders manager contact and suppresses queue for manager route, and renders queue for self-service.

labels.name: story
labels.value: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles

steps.name: Given: Given house A routes booking requests to its manager
Given: And house B permits resident self-service with a waiting queue
When: When residents view the booking route for their own house
Then: Then house A directs them to its manager and does not offer the queue
Then: And house B offers the route configured for its residents
